name: Open Source Maintainer Pack
description: Workflows for maintainers of open source projects: code review, technical documentation, safe deprecation and migration paths, changelog hygiene, security advisories, and contributor onboarding.
useCases: Review incoming pull requests for regressions, missing tests, and maintainability.
Write and maintain project documentation, changelogs, and contributor onboarding material.
Plan safe deprecations, dependency upgrades, and security advisories for a public project.
examplePrompts: Review this external PR for behavioral regressions and missing tests, and draft a constructive review comment.
Plan the deprecation of this public API, including timeline, changelog entries, and migration guide.
